title: Discord gives more advertisers more tools to target its users
gist: Discord launched Discord Ads Manager (self-service from early 2027) and rebranded video rewards ads as Video Quests Reserve to broaden its advertiser base and targeting, an ad push tied to its confidential January IPO filing; users worry ads could degrade the platform.

insights.claim: Discord announced Discord Ads Manager, a campaign platform with forecasting, objective-based bidding and performance monitoring, currently for select advertisers with self-service access in early 2027.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Self-serve ads can scale Discord's revenue to long-tail advertisers.
insights.locator: This week, the social media firm announced

insights.claim: Discord says self-service access opens advertising to smaller studios and marketers regardless of budget, who previously needed a direct sales relationship.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Broadening the advertiser base diversifies revenue ahead of an IPO.
insights.quote: opening the platform to advertisers, regardless of their budget

insights.claim: Discord renamed its Video Quests rewards ads to Video Quests Reserve, a premium reservation-based offering, and says new tools will bring expanded user targeting.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Premium formats and targeting raise ad yield potential.
insights.locator: The company is also expanding Video Quests

insights.claim: Discord, launched in 2015 without ads until Quests in 2024, is pushing ads in connection with its confidential January IPO filing to drive value beyond subscriptions and game sales.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Ad revenue growth will be central to Discord's IPO equity story.

insights.claim: Discord VP of Advertising Adam Bauer signaled more ad formats across the funnel, from brand awareness to app installs and purchases.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Signals rising ad load and monetization intensity ahead.

insights.claim: Users worry ads, age verification and AI moderation could fundamentally change Discord, and co-founder Stanislav Vishnevskiy says he constantly raises enshittification concerns internally.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Monetization must be balanced against engagement risk.
insights.quote: “I’m definitely the one who’s constantly bringing up enshittification [at internal meetings].

insights.claim: If Discord's ads become more aggressive in size or frequency, the company could quickly lose longtime users.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: User churn risk caps how fast Discord can grow ad load.
insights.quote: Should these ads become more aggressive, including in size or frequency, the company could quickly lose longtime users.
